takes place in a laboratory. The room the map is located in has grey walls and floor. It is quite empty, only having a few grey crates and what appears to be multiple monitors close to each other. On the walls, multiple screens can be found. There are also a few windows and gates, through which various halls are visible. These halls have doors, vending machines and benches. Multiple grey metal pipes can also be found on the walls.

The black path starts at the black door and ends at the white one. The path goes straight and then makes two loops, with a single straight path between them. After these two loops, the path goes straight again.

Zombies are on their way. Prepare to defend!
Make sure to place down some units near the path and upgrade them. Together, we've got this.
Alright! There are some Speedy enemies coming. They're fast, but weak.
You might need some more units to help defend if one slips by, so make sure your towers have enough path coverage to deal with them.
Up ahead are some Large Zombies. They're slow but have a lot of health.
You can command some of your towers to prioritize stronger targets, but make sure to keep a few focused on the weaker ones otherwise they might get by.
Heads up! You have a Boss Zombie coming! They can have special attributes that make them resistant to certain attacks.
Professor V has given us the technology that lets us see their stats and modifiers if you select them.
Also, we might have some Hidden enemies soon. Only some units can see them, so be sure to upgrade the ones that do.
There they are! Man, Hidden zombies are tough to see.
Here comes some Breakers! They can spawn additional weaker enemies. Too many at once could overwhelm your units if you're not careful.
Seems like the corpses attracted a Necromancer. They will raise the dead to make them... uh... less dead?
You might want to try prioritizing them here.
You're doing great, keep it up! Those armored enemies are tougher to deal with, but I'm sure you've got enough upgrades to deal with them
Woah! Did you feel the ground shake? Something big is coming!
We're not out of this yet, so don't get comfortable!
It's those fast zombies again! Slowing units like Freezer can give our team more time to take them down.
All that fighting attracted the Brute!
Let's give it all we got!
One icon and dialogue is randomly chosen upon defeat:
•Mission Failed, we'll get em' next time.
•Mistakes are just part of the journey..
Zombies were spotted down the path! Prepare to defend!
Place down your units and upgrade them! We got this!
Speedys incoming! They're weak, but never underestimate your enemies.
Strategize your next move. Great unit positioning wins even toughest battles.
Large zombies approaching! They're slow, but they can take a beating!
Command some of your units by making them target stronger enemies. A healthy balance will win us this fight!
Boss zombie spotted! And he looks MAD!
Get ready! This won't be easy!
I just spotted some Hidden zombies sneaking through!
Upgrade your units to detect these tricky enemies!
Here come breakers! They'll spawn more zombies upon death, be careful!
Looks like ending all of those zombies attracted a Necromancer!
Don't give him a chance to raise the undead!
Those minions are tricky, but destroy them as fast as possible!
That won't stop them—more enemies are on their way!
Can you feel the ground shake? Something big is almost here...
Give it all you got! Take it down!
My sensors indicate a Hidden Boss was waiting in the shadows.
It's making its move! You think you could slip by us!
Fast zombies! You know what to do!
Units that can slow make quick work out of these guys.
You'd think they'd learn but I guess they've lost their brains long ago!
That boss is fast but our bullets are faster.
Defeating all those enemies attracted the Brute!
Let's send this Brute back to where it came from!
One icon and dialogue is randomly chosen upon defeat:
•Mission Failed, we'll get em' next time.
•Mistakes are just part of the journey..
Zombies have been spotted along the path!
Place down your units close to the path and defend!
They may be fast, but they're weaker.
Quick bursts of damage on these enemies and we'll do just fine!
Tankier zombies are starting to seep in!
They may be slow, but they are harder to bring down! Stay vigilant!.
The zombie onslaught is bringing in a boss zombie!
Prepare and upgrade your units and HOLD YOUR GROUND!
I just spotted some Hidden zombies coming in!
Upgrade your units to detect these tricky enemies!
They'll turn into a different zombie when killed! I wonder what's inside them?
Looks like the zombie horde is "summoning" a Necromancer.
Don't let them get the chance to raise even more zombies!
Loud thuds in the distance? I don't like what I'm hearing..
It sounds like something huge is coming! Prepare!
A fast boss that's ALSO hidden?
Please tell me you've got units to detect it by now..
Very quick zombies are closing in fast!
Get a unit to slow these guys down or we may have a problem.
I thought we were going to die for a second there!
Well, the battle isn't over yet! Get ready for another hoard!
The grave digger has arrived to dig our graves!
This is a fight for life or death! Give it your best!
One icon and dialogue is randomly chosen upon defeat:
•Mission Failed, we'll get em' next time.
•Mistakes are just part of the journey..
